about_the_game:
This is a casual card-building strategy Rouge game. You need to select a large number of random cards to build your own unique deck. The cards will be automatically arranged randomly and the score will be calculated based on the bond rules between the cards. With the help of strategy and luck, strive for a high score!

Background Introduction

In your previous life, you found a mediocre job because of poor college entrance examination results and died suddenly. However, you were reborn and received assistance from an exam system. In this life, you are bound to pass the college entrance examination and be listed on the honor roll!

In-game game-play process

You need to study according to the process stipulated by the system, obtain scores from the knowledge (cards) and test your scores in the exam:

1. Comprehension: Randomly extract as much knowledge as possible from your memory and place it in your mind in a random order. Earn points based on the characteristics, positions, and connections of the knowledge

2. Learning: Select one knowledge option from several options for learning and incorporate it into your memory

3. Exam: After alternating between comprehension and learning several times, you will face an exam. A certain number of points will be deducted from the exam. If the score is not sufficient to deduct, the game will fail

Out-of-game gift unlocked

Each time you pass an exam within the game, you will gain a certain number of gift points. Completing a game will also earn you gift points. Gift points can be unlocked in the gift tree system outside the game. Talents include unlocking new knowledge, upgrading unlocked knowledge, and unlocking new functions, etc
